site_description: Write BraceML and see it compiled to HTML, Svelte 5 and React as you type.
copy_failed: Couldn't copy. Copy the link from the address bar.
preview_unavailable: The preview uses the HTML target, which has no blocks or expressions. See the Svelte and React tabs.
convert_intro: Paste HTML and get BraceML. It runs @braceml/convert in your browser, the same converter as braceml convert on the command line. Nothing is sent to a server.
keep_class_attribute: Keep classes in a class attribute (for Tailwind)
docs_english_only: The docs are in English for now.
